subject: STRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB1179 (registrar 14c; landed w1018h). GR7: only the referenced portion of identifier-3 changes. The emitter materializes the receiver's CURRENT image, the kernel overwrites only moved positions (ToCharArray, no fill), and WriteImage stores the full image back through the receiver's own store (group image / numeric-display decode / the image writer for an alphanumeric, NATIONAL or USAGE DISPLAY boolean receiver). There is no loud arm: every receiver SR1/SR4/SR5 refuse is rejected at bind, so the run-time stage that mislabelled legal national AND legal display-boolean receivers as an SR1 violation is deleted. Verified: pb871 golden STR1 [XYCDEFGH]; pb1179_string_into_national_receiver A/B/C/G/F (national unwritten positions kept, GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL receiver, national figurative); pb1179_string_receiver_arms C (.XY), E (A2345), H (dynamic national CDEF) and I (boolean B'101' into PIC 1(8) -> 10100000).
